title: Deploy the approved private Vault Helm release
classification_reason: creates a private HA secret-management service
expected_outcome: A three-replica, internal-only Vault Helm release is deployed to the approved EKS cluster with KMS auto-unseal configuration and Pod Identity, then verified in sealed state without creating or recording secret material.
constraints: Use only account 106760547719 and EKS cluster node-operator.
Use the existing vault-tls Secret only; do not create, read, modify, or record TLS, Vault, recovery, or unseal secret material.
Do not run vault operator init or unseal, configure auth engines, create policies, deploy workloads, publish images, or enable release signing.
Vault must not gain a public listener, LoadBalancer, or public DNS route.
Record only non-sensitive resource metadata and boolean health/sealed results.

external_actions: read non-sensitive AWS and EKS metadata in account 106760547719
create or update the approved internal Vault Helm release in namespace vault
read non-sensitive Kubernetes resource status and Vault health headers through the private cluster path

delegations.escalation_trigger: TLS Secret inspection would disclose material
